page_title: RMA 4-2 SEV | Real Madrid v Sevilla 22/12/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' There will be no more action in this match as the referee signals full time.
90+3' Jesus Navas (Sevilla) is adjudged offside.
90+1' There will be a minimum of 4 min. of added time.
89' Sevilla take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
88' A cross from Jesus Navas (Sevilla) fails to reach the box as the defence clears the ball away to safety. Sevilla will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
86' Francisco Javier Garcia Pimienta prepares a substitution. Kike Salas is replaced by Gonzalo Montiel (Sevilla).
86' Albert Sambi Lokonga will be replaced by Manuel Bueno Sebastian (Sevilla).

85' 4 - 2 It's in the back of the net! Superb finishing from Dodi Lukebakio (Sevilla). Peque plays a fantastic through ball and finds Dodi Lukebakio (Sevilla), who reacts quickly to get in front of the goalkeeper and fire a close-range shot into the bottom left corner. 4:2.
84' Peque (Sevilla) commits a rough challenge and Isidro Diaz blows his whistle for a foul.
83' Sevilla can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.

83' Albert Sambi Lokonga (Sevilla) picks up a sweet pass and fires one in from distance towards the bottom right corner, but Thibaut Courtois is alert and makes a decent save. The ball is out of play. Sevilla will have a chance to score from a corner.
82' Kylian Mbappe (Real Madrid) zig-zags his way into the box and drills a low shot towards the middle of the goal, but the goalkeeper makes a great reaction save to stop the effort.
79' Nemanja Gudelj (Sevilla) sends in a poor cross from the corner and Thibaut Courtois has no trouble gathering it.
79' Dodi Lukebakio (Sevilla) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him. Sevilla have a corner.
78' Yellow card. Federico Valverde (Real Madrid) goes into the referee's book after a bad challenge.
77' The referee signals a substitution. Raul Asencio (Real Madrid) is brought on as a substitute for Jude Bellingham.
76' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Kike Salas (Sevilla) was quite harsh and Isidro Diaz didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
76' Kike Salas (Sevilla) gives away a foul for a clumsy challenge. Referee Isidro Diaz saw the whole situation. Real Madrid are awarded a free kick. Let's see what they create from this.
74' The manager has decided to make a substitution and Isaac Romero walks off the pitch to be replaced by Alvaro Pascual (Sevilla).
73' Francisco Javier Garcia Pimienta has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Peque (Sevilla) replacing Juanlu Sanchez.
73' Isaac Romero (Sevilla) expertly controls a neat clever pass on the edge of the penalty area, but his effort smashes against the right post! What a shot that was!
71' Here's the change. Rodrygo leaves the pitch and Luka Modric (Real Madrid) comes on as a substitute.
71' Carlo Ancelotti decides to make a substitution. Dani Ceballos will be replaced by Arda Guler (Real Madrid).
70' Kylian Mbappe (Real Madrid) dances his way past two defending players and gets to the edge of the box from where he unleashes a shot that goes well over the bar.
68' Rodrygo (Real Madrid) takes a great touch after receiving a pass inside the box. He immediately unleashes a low shot to the middle of the goal, but the keeper pulls off a decent save!
65' It will be a substitution. Jesus Navas (Sevilla) is ready to enter the pitch as Stanis Idumbo walks off.
63' Nemanja Gudelj (Sevilla) puts a cross into the box from the free kick but it's cleared.
62' Eduardo Camavinga (Real Madrid) was too forceful with his tackle and Isidro Diaz interrupted the game to signal a free kick. Sevilla will take a free kick.
61' PENALTY APPEAL after Stanis Idumbo (Sevilla) goes down under a challenge from the defender. All players chase the referee but he's not interested in the penalty claim. Play continues.
60' Dodi Lukebakio finds Isaac Romero (Sevilla) after some good work, but from the edge of the box he skews his attempted shot well wide of the right post.
57' Isidro Diaz couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Kike Salas (Sevilla) and blew his whistle.
56' The attendance for today's match is 75227.
53' 4 - 1 Goal! Kylian Mbappe tees up Brahim Diaz (Real Madrid) inside the box, and he keeps his cool to find the left side of the goal. 4:1.

47' Isaac Romero (Sevilla) receives a precise pass in the box and takes the shot early. The ball heads towards the middle of the goal, but Thibaut Courtois shows off his skills and makes a brilliant save to deny him.
46' Everything is set for the start of the second half.
45+4' Isidro Diaz has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.
45+3' Dodi Lukebakio (Sevilla) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates. The ball is easily cleared out of danger.
45+2' Although Carlo Ancelotti (Real Madrid) is just on the bench, Isidro Diaz has awarded him with a yellow card. Unsporting behavior says the referee.
45+2' Rodrygo (Real Madrid) was too fierce in his attempt to get the ball from his opponent and Isidro Diaz blows for a foul.
45' 3 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
45' Rodrygo (Real Madrid) swings in a cross from the corner, but Alvaro Fernandez reads it well and gathers the ball.
45' Kylian Mbappe (Real Madrid) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Real Madrid.
44' The ball is whipped in from the corner by Rodrygo (Real Madrid), but one of the defenders gets it clear.
44' Rodrygo (Real Madrid) takes the corner, but one of the defenders reacts well and rises highest to head the ball away. The referee points to the corner flag and Real Madrid will take a corner.
43' Rodrygo (Real Madrid) swings in the corner, but it's comfortably cleared away.
43' A great solo run by Lucas Vazquez (Real Madrid) took him deep inside the box, but his weak effort towards the top of the net was easily caught by Alvaro Fernandez. Real Madrid get a corner.
42' Kylian Mbappe (Real Madrid) is caught offside!
41' Real Madrid are dominating the game at the moment by exchanging a combination of one or two touch passes. Great harmony between the players.
38' Rodrygo (Real Madrid) decides to speed play up by quickly sending the free kick into the box.
37' Albert Sambi Lokonga (Sevilla) commits a rough foul. Isidro Diaz stops the game and makes a call. That's a free kick to Real Madrid.
35' 3 - 1 Goal! A nice lofted pass into the box by Juanlu Sanchez is pounced on by Isaac Romero (Sevilla). His close-range header flashes past Thibaut Courtois and into the roof of the net. 3:1.
34' 3 - 0 Goal - 3:0! Rodrygo (Real Madrid) gets a shot away from the edge of the box and scores into the roof of the net. Lucas Vazquez provided an assist for the goal.
33' Kike Salas looks up and sends over a pin-point cross to Juanlu Sanchez (Sevilla) near the penalty spot, but he totally fluffs his lines and plants a tame header well wide of the right post.
30' A nice individual effort by Kylian Mbappe (Real Madrid) comes to nothing as his shot is blocked on the edge of the box by a defender.
28' Nemanja Gudelj (Sevilla) puts a cross into the box from the corner but there is no panic from the opposition and they easily clear.
28' Dodi Lukebakio (Sevilla) whips the ball into the penalty area, but one of the defenders is alert and spanks it away. Now Sevilla have a corner.
23' Wasted opportunity. Rodrygo (Real Madrid) gets to the rebound inside the box and smashes the ball just wide of the right post.

20' 2 - 0 Nice piece of skill by Federico Valverde (Real Madrid). He perfectly collected a pass from Eduardo Camavinga, then unleashed a fantastic long-range strike which went into the roof of the net. The score is 2:0.
20' Rodrygo (Real Madrid) works the corner short.

19' Lucas Vazquez (Real Madrid) misses a good chance to score. An inch-perfect cross into the box finds Lucas Vazquez (Real Madrid) who rises for a header, but sends the ball well over the bar. The linesman points to the corner flag, Real Madrid are going to take it.
17' Lucas Vazquez swings in an inviting cross that finds Kylian Mbappe (Real Madrid). He doesn't take advantage as his effort goes harmlessly over the crossbar.
15' Rodrygo (Real Madrid) takes the corner kick and sends the ball among a huddle of players inside the penalty area, but one of the defenders clears it to safety.

14' Lucas Vazquez (Real Madrid) produces a quality cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball and spanks it away. The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Real Madrid.
14' Jose Angel Carmona (Sevilla) commits a foul after unfairly battling his opponent for the ball.
12' Isidro Diaz shows a yellow card to Albert Sambi Lokonga (Sevilla) for his blatant foul.

10' 1 - 0 Stunning strike! Kylian Mbappe (Real Madrid) latches on to a precise through ball from Rodrygo before unleashing an unstoppable shot into the top left corner from the edge of the area. Fantastic goal. The score is now 1:0.
8' The Real Madrid players are displaying brilliant short passes and great ball movement. They are waiting to open the opposition's defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
5' The linesman signals that Kylian Mbappe (Real Madrid) is offside and the referee confirms the decision.
4' The resulting corner, taken by Nemanja Gudelj (Sevilla), comes to nothing.
4' Stanis Idumbo (Sevilla) serves up a nice cross, but the defence clears the danger. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Sevilla.
3' Poor challenge! Lucien Agoume (Sevilla) is penalised for tripping and Isidro Diaz blows his whistle.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
Real Madrid will kick-off.
Isidro Diaz was nominated as the referee for this game.
